title: Newline in address
goal: controls the position of line breaks in a contact address.
summary: Source line breaks in plain HTML text often collapse into whitespace. br Move to the next line within the same paragraph, often used in addresses and poetry.
tasks: retains the two span text in address.
Add a br between these two spans so that the room number is displayed on the line below the street address.
hint:
Write
after the first and before the second . br itself represents a newline.

example.code:
Night falls into the lake
Street light on the bridge
example.note: Two lines of short poetry belong to the same paragraph, and br marks the boundary between lines of poetry.
